## T. A. when deputed for training  
[ Swamy's -  
FR & SR, Part-II]  
1. An employee deputed to undergo a course of training in India (refresher I in-service/ pre-promotional) is entitled to draw T.A. and D.A. as on tour as follows:-  
When boarding and lodging not provided-  
First 180 days  
Full D.A.  
Beyond 180 days  
Nil  
Training Institutes where boarding and lodging facilities exist (including mess run on co-operative basis at the training centre)  
First 30 days  
Full D.A.  
Next 150 days
